Key Achievements

Highlights

🏆
Top Innovation Choice Award 2022

TICMIEDU — First of Its Kind in Indonesia

Served as Project Manager for TICMIEDU, Indonesia's first capital market digital education platform. Launched at the IDX Main Hall in September 2022, the platform received the Top Innovation Choice Award 2022 by Tras N Co Indonesia. Led content management, video learning production, and strategic institutional partnerships throughout the project.

🎓
Executive Program

Corporate Learning for BUMN Board-Level Leaders

Actively involved in designing and executing exclusive, paid executive programs attended by Boards of Directors and Commissioners from major BUMN companies — including Investment Strategies & Portfolio Management and Corporate Law for Executive — delivered at five-star venues with 100+ senior executives per event.

📋
Advisory & Consulting

Beyond Training — Full-Spectrum Professional Consulting

My scope extends beyond training delivery. Through collaboration with my team, I can facilitate introductions and connections to advisory services covering areas such as IPO Readiness, Business Process Consulting, Executive Search, ESG, Good Corporate Governance (GCG), and Fraud Risk Management — helping corporate clients navigate the right professionals for their specific needs. This network approach allows me to serve clients more holistically, while currently managing 5+ active corporate consultations per month.
